title: Settings

gameLanguage.label: Game language
gameLanguage.hint: The words in Termo and Wend, and what the chess coach says. It does not change the interface.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: Short tones for moves, mistakes and solving.

vibration.label: Vibration
vibration.unsupported: This device does not support vibration.

note: These settings apply to every game. Progress, streaks and best times are stored on this device. A solved daily puzzle also sends its time to the ranking, under a generated name you can change there. Animations follow your system's reduced motion setting.
